## Welcome!
I am an astronomer and data scientist passionate about space-based observations and remote sensing.
Currently, I am a postdoctoral researcher at the University of Arizona and involved into the development of the [Aspera space mission](https://news.arizona.edu/news/uarizona-will-lead-nasa-space-telescope-mission-reveal-unseen-dynamic-lives-galaxies).
I have obtained my PhD from the University of Heidelberg working on multi-wavelength observations of planet-forming disks. I am passionate about data science, software development and data management in diverse applications and contexts.
